about: Stations the place search does not find because OpenStreetMap draws them as not open (pipeline/place_index.py, station_skipped_not_open). An internal watch file (owner, 2026-10-11), never page text. A row leaves when OSM marks the station open and the city's index is rebuilt from a new cache. 'open_namesake_in_index' is true where an open station of the same name is findable. 'line' comes with 'line_source' (relation: a route relation the station is a member of; tag: a tag on the station or its track; source: a published page, read on the date noted, where OSM cannot say); a null line carries 'line_reason' and is never a guess. scripts/check_place_unopened.py holds the rows to each city's last index build.
